text: jHDF 0.12.0 does not expose a writer API for unsigned fixed-point dataset datatypes; WritableGroup only accepts Object data and FixedPoint(int) is signed. For current ScalaFIM archives, preserve UInt8/UInt16 semantics through the LNA manifest plus per-dataset logical dtype attrs. If external HDF5 tools must see native unsigned integer types, split that into a jHDF fork/native-backend task.
